derived_from.purpose: post-hoc derived analysis: GF(2) rank of the four SINGLE-BIT toggle vectors (vals[1<<r] ^ vals[0], r=0..3), projected to the 12-bit matching window and to the full 32-bit component. This is the first-order (linear) rank; the nonlinear 16-point image (distinct counts) is the pre-registered RC-1 measurement, and the two are reported separately because the step algebra is a multiplexer, not a linear map. Primary object read from recorded values_32bit; null object deterministically re-derived from the identical frozen observable (its record stores distinct counts only). Rank implementation cross-checked against exhaustive closure enumeration on 30000 random 4-tuples (0 mismatches).
derived_from.status_label: derived analysis (not a pre-registered measurement); no new random draws
